author: KEXP
description: Under the musical project Prewn, Izzy Hagerup opens up her journal and delivers captivating sonic expressions layered with intimate lyricism and sinister strings. Her in-studio session offers a commanding performance of “Ticks” and more.
title: Prewn performs "Ticks" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
